http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHMO_0001.label: 高效液相色谱法
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHMO_0001.description: CHMO high-performance liquid chromatography (offline MIREOT stub).

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/DRON_0000.label: 临床药物角色
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/DRON_0000.description: DrOn clinical drug role (offline MIREOT stub).

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C630.label: 使用中污染
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C630.description: NCIT contamination during use (offline MIREOT stub).

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OBI_00000.label: 测定
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OBI_00000.description: OBI assay — 检验材料实体以产出信息的计划过程 (offline MIREOT stub).

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OBI_00006.label: 标本采集过程
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OBI_00006.description: OBI specimen collection process (offline MIREOT stub).

https://atcddd.fhi.no/atc_ddd_index/?cod.label: 性激素及生殖系统调节剂
https://atcddd.fhi.no/atc_ddd_index/?cod.description: WHO ATC G03 sex hormones and modulators of the genital system (offline MIREOT stub; ✓ T021 核实).

https://atcddd.fhi.no/atc_ddd_index/?cod.label: 全身用皮质激素
https://atcddd.fhi.no/atc_ddd_index/?cod.description: WHO ATC H02 corticosteroids for systemic use (offline MIREOT stub; ✓ T021 核实).

https://atcddd.fhi.no/atc_ddd_index/?cod.label: β-内酰胺类抗菌药，青霉素类
https://atcddd.fhi.no/atc_ddd_index/?cod.description: WHO ATC J01C beta-lactam antibacterials, penicillins (offline MIREOT stub; ✓ T021 核实).

https://atcddd.fhi.no/atc_ddd_index/?cod.label: 抗肿瘤药
https://atcddd.fhi.no/atc_ddd_index/?cod.description: WHO ATC L01 antineoplastic agents (offline MIREOT stub; ✓ T021 核实).

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/cle.label: 目视检查
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/cle.description: Minimum requirement per CFDI but insufficient as sole criterion.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/con.label: 空气传播
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/con.description: Contamination via particles or aerosols dispersed through air flow.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/con.label: 混淆事件
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/con.description: Product/material mix-up due to system design flaws or human error.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/con.label: 污染事件
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/con.description: A process in which one drug product contaminates another via one of four pathways defined by CFDI.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/con.label: 机械转移
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/con.description: Contamination via external equipment surfaces transferred by personnel clothing/gloves.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/con.label: 残留污染
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/con.description: Contamination via product residue on equipment internal (product-contact) surfaces not cleaned below acceptable limits.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/doc.label: 研发阶段
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/doc.description: The drug R&D lifecycle phase a document or entity is situated in. Shared reference-value individuals (enumeration), hand-authored in T-Box like risk:RiskLevel; used as traceability metadata and risk/compliance context.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/doc.label: 法规文档
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/doc.description: An R&D-phase document tracked as a first-class traceability/compliance anchor (ALCOA+). Its lifecycle metadata (type/version/status/development phase/source system/SHA) is the fact; its internal business entities are extraction candidates.

declared_properties.label: 文档名称
declared_properties.description: The stable display name of a regulatory document record, including its filename extension when available.

declared_properties.label: CTD 模块编号
declared_properties.description: ICH Common Technical Document module reference, e.g. 2.5, 3.2.S, 5.3.5.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 急性毒性试验
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Single-dose toxicity studies to determine the short-term toxic effects and LD50/MTD.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: BLA 生物制品许可申请
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Biologics License Application submission to NMPA for marketing authorization of a biological product.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: CMC 开发
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls development: drug substance/product process development, formulation, analytical method development, quality standards.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: CMC 报告
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls documentation: drug substance/product specification, manufacturing process, analytical methods.

declared_relationships.label: 描述
declared_relationships.description: Links a CMC report to the drug product / drug substance it documents.

declared_relationships.label: 含清洗方法
declared_relationships.description: Links a CMC report to the equipment cleaning process described therein.

declared_relationships.label: 含清洗残留物
declared_relationships.description: Links a CMC report to the residue information for cleaning validation.

declared_relationships.label: 含降解途径
declared_relationships.description: Links a CMC report or parent degradation pathway to its sub-pathways.

declared_relationships.label: 含备样生产计划
declared_relationships.description: Links a CMC report to the clinical sample production plan it describes.

declared_relationships.label: 存放条件
declared_relationships.description: Links a CMC report, synthesis step, or process intermediate to its storage conditions.

declared_relationships.label: 使用设备
declared_relationships.description: Links a synthesis step or CMC report to the equipment required.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: CTD 模块1（行政信息）
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Region-specific administrative information and prescribing information.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: CTD 模块2（综述）
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Quality Overall Summary (QOS), Nonclinical Overview/Summary, Clinical Overview/Summary.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: CTD 模块3（药学）
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Drug substance and drug product quality data: manufacturing process, specifications, stability.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: CTD 模块4（非临床）
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Nonclinical study reports: pharmacology, pharmacokinetics, toxicology.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: CTD 模块5（临床）
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Clinical study reports and related information.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 候选药物确定（Pre-IND）
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Final selection of the drug candidate to advance into formal preclinical development based on efficacy, safety, developability, and IP considerations.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 致癌性试验
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Long-term carcinogenicity studies (ICH S1A/S1B); typically required for drugs intended for chronic use (>6 months).

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 临床概述
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: CTD Module 2.5: critical analysis of all clinical data.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 临床备样生产计划
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: The planned production of clinical trial sample batches described in a CMC report: production date, workshop, batch count, purpose, and expected batch size.

declared_properties.label: 计划生产时间
declared_properties.description: Planned production month, e.g. 2026-02.

declared_properties.label: 生产用途
declared_properties.description: Intended use of the produced batch, e.g. 临床I期试验.

declared_relationships.label: 生产车间
declared_relationships.description: Links a production plan to the workshop / production area where the batch is produced, e.g. 642/646车间.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 临床试验报告（CSR）
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: ICH E3 formatted report of an individual clinical study.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 临床总结
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: CTD Module 2.7: summary of clinical pharmacology, efficacy, and safety.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 临床试验
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: A planned process of systematic investigation in human subjects to evaluate the safety and efficacy of a drug candidate.

declared_properties.label: 受试者人群
declared_properties.description: Description of enrolled subjects, e.g. healthy volunteers, target indication patients.

declared_properties.label: 目标适应症
declared_properties.description: Intended therapeutic indication. Applies both to a clinical trial and to the drug product / substance itself (e.g. 用于革兰氏阴性菌感染的治疗).

declared_properties.label: 试验设计
declared_properties.description: Study design descriptor, e.g. randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center.

declared_relationships.label: 评价
declared_relationships.description: Links a clinical trial to the drug product being evaluated.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 降解途径
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: A characterized forced-degradation pathway of the drug substance used for cleaning validation and stability assessment.

declared_properties.label: 降解条件
declared_properties.description: E.g. 0.1mol/L HCl, 60℃/4h.

declared_properties.label: 主要降解杂质
declared_properties.description: E.g. Imp-A, Imp-B, Imp-C.

declared_relationships.label: 含降解途径
declared_relationships.description: Links a CMC report or parent degradation pathway to its sub-pathways.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 药品检验
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Sample testing and verification by the National Institutes for Food and Drug Control (中检院).

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 药品注册证书
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: 《药品注册证书》issued by NMPA upon marketing authorization approval.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: Ⅱ期结束沟通会
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Pre-Phase III communication meeting with health authority to agree on Phase III trial design.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 核查中心现场核查
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: On-site inspection by NMPA Center for Inspection to verify clinical trial data integrity and GCP compliance.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 遗传毒性试验
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Standard battery (ICH S2(R1)): bacterial reverse mutation, in vitro mammalian chromosomal aberration or micronucleus, in vivo assay.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: GxP 要求
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Good practice requirement applicable to a specific development stage.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 高通量筛选
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Automated large-scale screening of compound/biological molecule libraries against validated targets to identify initial hits.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: IND 批准（临床试验许可）
IND 临床试验申请
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Investigational New Drug application submitted to health authority (NMPA/FDA/EMA) to permit first-in-human clinical trials.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 免疫毒性试验
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Assessment of potential adverse effects on the immune system (ICH S8).

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 研究者手册（IB）
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: ICH E6(R2) required compilation of clinical and nonclinical data relevant to the investigational product.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 先导化合物优化
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Iterative medicinal chemistry and early ADME/toxicity profiling to improve hit compounds into viable lead candidates.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 上市批准
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Granting of the Drug Registration Certificate (《药品注册证书》), permitting commercial production and sale.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: NDA 新药上市申请
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: New Drug Application submission to NMPA for marketing authorization of a chemical drug.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 定期安全性更新报告（PSUR/PBRER）
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: ICH E2C(R2): periodic benefit-risk evaluation report submitted to health authorities.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 药代动力学研究（ADME）
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Nonclinical studies characterizing absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion of the drug candidate.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 药物警戒
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Ongoing science and activities relating to the detection, assessment, understanding and prevention of adverse effects or any other drug-related problem.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: Ⅰ期临床试验
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: First-in-human study: safety, tolerability, PK/PD in healthy volunteers (or patients for oncology), typically 20-100 subjects. Determines maximum tolerated dose (MTD).

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: Ⅱ期临床试验
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Exploratory therapeutic trial in target indication patients: preliminary efficacy, dose-finding, further safety. Typically tens to hundreds of subjects.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: Ⅲ期临床试验
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Confirmatory trial: multi-center, randomized, controlled study in target patients to establish efficacy and safety as the basis for marketing authorization. Typically hundreds to thousands of subjects.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: Ⅱa期临床试验（概念验证）
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Proof-of-concept (PoC) study: initial signal of efficacy in target patients.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: Ⅱb期临床试验（剂量探索）
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Dose-ranging study: identifies optimal dose(s) for confirmatory Phase III trials.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: Ⅳ期临床试验
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Post-marketing study: further efficacy/safety evaluation, new indication exploration, conducted after marketing authorization.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 上市后变更申请
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Regulatory submission for post-approval changes in manufacturing process, specifications, or other CMC attributes.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 临床前研究
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Umbrella class for all nonclinical studies conducted prior to first-in-human dosing.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 主要药效学
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Studies of the desired therapeutic effect of the drug candidate on the target indication.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 工艺辅助物料
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Protective gas (N2), process water, etc.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 工艺中间体
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: A chemical entity produced at an intermediate synthesis step, not the final API.

declared_properties.label: 中间体标识
declared_properties.description:
An identifier stated for a process intermediate, e.g. SM5592-A14. A bare value is unique only within an explicitly established project or synthesis-route namespace.
原文明示的工艺中间体标识，例如 SM5592-A14。单独标识值仅在已明确建立的项目或合成路线命名空间内具有唯一性。

declared_relationships.label: 存放条件
declared_relationships.description: Links a CMC report, synthesis step, or process intermediate to its storage conditions.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 工艺物料
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: A material consumed in drug substance manufacturing: starting material, solvent, reagent, catalyst, or process aid.

declared_properties.label: 物料规格/级别
declared_properties.description: E.g. 原料药级, 分析纯, 工业级, CP级.

declared_properties.label: 物料用途
declared_properties.description: E.g. 起始物料, 反应溶剂, 萃取溶剂, 析晶溶剂, 保护气体.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 生产风险评估
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Broader HazID-dimension production risk assessment covering personnel, equipment, materials, documents, and waste management — the full 7-column risk evaluation table.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 质量风险评估
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Assessment of quality risks during manufacturing: impurity carry-over, incomplete reaction, product degradation, contamination.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 再注册
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Periodic renewal of the drug registration certificate (NMPA every 5 years).

declared_properties.label: 反应类型
declared_properties.description: E.g. Suzuki coupling, amide condensation, deprotection.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 法规里程碑
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: An information entity representing a key regulatory decision point in the drug development lifecycle.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 药品注册申报
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Planned process of compiling and submitting a regulatory dossier (CMC, nonclinical, clinical) to a health authority for marketing authorization.

declared_properties.label: 药品监管机构
declared_properties.description: Name of the regulatory authority: NMPA, FDA, EMA, PMDA, etc.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 长期毒性试验
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Repeated-dose toxicity studies of duration aligned with intended clinical exposure (ICH M3(R2)).

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 生殖毒性试验
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Fertility, embryo-fetal development, pre/postnatal development studies (ICH S5(R3)).

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 风险管理计划（RMP）
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: ICH E2E: a set of pharmacovigilance activities and interventions designed to identify, characterize, prevent, or minimize risks relating to a medicinal product.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 安全药理学
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Studies assessing potential undesirable effects on physiological functions (cardiovascular, CNS, respiratory — ICH S7A/S7B core battery).

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 安全风险评估
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Assessment of occupational safety risks during manufacturing: flammability, toxicity exposure, oxygen depletion, thermal runaway.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 次要药效学
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Studies of unintended pharmacological effects (mode of action not related to the desired therapeutic effect).

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 共线评估数据
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Aggregated toxicological and dosing data required for shared-line (SLPRA) production risk assessment: NOAEL, F-factor, PDE, daily dose, and degradation profiles.

declared_properties.label: 给药方案
declared_properties.description: E.g. QD口服, 21天为一个治疗周期.

declared_properties.label: NOAEL 试验周期
declared_properties.description: E.g. 28天重复给药.

declared_properties.label: NOAEL 动物种属
declared_properties.description: E.g. SD大鼠, Beagle犬.

declared_properties.label: NOAEL（mg/kg/天）
declared_properties.description: No Observed Adverse Effect Level from repeat-dose toxicity study.

declared_properties.label: 安全系数（F值）
declared_properties.description: Composite safety factor per ICH S9 (oncology) or standard PDE derivation: product of F1-F5.

declared_relationships.label: 基于毒性特征
declared_relationships.description: Cross-module link from shared-line assessment data to the drug module's toxicity profile. Distinct local name from slpra-drug:hasToxicityProfile (API → ToxicityProfile).

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 存放条件
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Specified storage requirements for an intermediate or drug substance: temperature, humidity, light protection, packaging, and shelf life / retest period.

declared_properties.label: 包装方式
declared_properties.description: E.g. 双层聚乙烯薄膜袋外加铝箔袋, 旋蒸瓶.

declared_properties.label: 有效期/复测期
declared_properties.description: E.g. 15天, 1个月, 1年.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 合成路线
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: The overall synthetic pathway from starting materials through intermediates to the drug substance (API). A route comprises an ordered chain of SynthesisSteps.

declared_properties.label: 工艺依据
declared_properties.description:
The source-document section or controlled reference on which the process route is based.
工艺路线所依据的源文章节或受控文件引用，例如3.1.1合成路线图。

declared_properties.label: 工艺名称
declared_properties.description:
The business-facing name of the overall manufacturing process represented by the route, e.g. crystallization purification.
该路线所表示的整体生产工艺名称，例如结晶纯化。

declared_relationships.label: 产出最终产品/API
declared_relationships.description:
Links a synthesis route or its final synthesis step to the DrugProduct or API that is its final output. Process intermediates must use producesIntermediate instead.
连接合成路线或其最终合成步骤与最终产出的药物产品或原料药（API）；工艺中间体应使用 producesIntermediate。

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 合成步骤
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: A single unit operation within a synthesis route (e.g. Suzuki coupling, deprotection, salt formation, purification).

declared_properties.label: 过程控制
declared_properties.description: IPC method and acceptance criteria, e.g. TLC endpoint, HPLC purity.

declared_properties.label: 反应条件
declared_properties.description: Temperature, pressure, atmosphere, duration, catalyst loading, etc.

declared_relationships.label: 存放条件
declared_relationships.description: Links a CMC report, synthesis step, or process intermediate to its storage conditions.

declared_relationships.label: 下一步骤
declared_relationships.description: Ordered chain linking synthesis steps within a route.

declared_relationships.label: 产出最终产品/API
declared_relationships.description:
Links a synthesis route or its final synthesis step to the DrugProduct or API that is its final output. Process intermediates must use producesIntermediate instead.
连接合成路线或其最终合成步骤与最终产出的药物产品或原料药（API）；工艺中间体应使用 producesIntermediate。

declared_relationships.label: 产出中间体
declared_relationships.description:
Links a synthesis step to a non-final process intermediate that it produces. Multiple values are allowed; process order is carried by the synthesis steps, not by the order of these assertions.
连接合成步骤及其产出的非最终工艺中间体。允许多个值；工艺顺序由合成步骤表达，不依赖这些断言的排列顺序。

declared_relationships.label: 使用设备
declared_relationships.description: Links a synthesis step or CMC report to the equipment required.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 靶点发现与验证
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Identification and validation of biological targets (receptors, enzymes, ion channels, etc.) for therapeutic intervention.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: CDE 技术审评
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Technical review by the Center for Drug Evaluation (CDE) of NMPA.

declared_properties.label: 产品或原料药唯一标识
declared_properties.description: 原文明示的产品/API标识；不以名称、共同项目、设备型号或试验用药名称替代具体实例身份。存在批次、规格等区分时须能唯一指向该实例，否则不可据此归并。

declared_relationships.label: 含工艺中间体
declared_relationships.description:
Product/API-level multi-valued view derived from an explicitly linked final synthesis route or final synthesis step. It is not derived merely because a report mentions both a product and a route.
由已明确关联的最终合成路线或最终合成步骤推导出的产品/API级多值视图；不得仅因同一报告同时提及产品和路线而推导。

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 药物产品
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: A finished dosage form drug product that bears a clinical drug role.

declared_properties.label: 注册分类
declared_properties.description: NMPA registration classification of the drug, e.g. 化学药品3类, 化学药品1类, 治疗用生物制品.

declared_properties.label: 申报/注册状态
declared_properties.description: Current regulatory submission status, e.g. 已申报临床/IND已受理, 已获批临床, 已申报上市/NDA.

declared_properties.label: 目标适应症
declared_properties.description: Intended therapeutic indication. Applies both to a clinical trial and to the drug product / substance itself (e.g. 用于革兰氏阴性菌感染的治疗).

declared_properties.label: 规格
declared_properties.description: Product specification or strength descriptor. For a bulk drug substance this may simply be 原料药; for a finished product e.g. 0.25g/片, 100mg/支.

declared_properties.label: 产品或原料药唯一标识
declared_properties.description: 原文明示的产品/API标识；不以名称、共同项目、设备型号或试验用药名称替代具体实例身份。存在批次、规格等区分时须能唯一指向该实例，否则不可据此归并。

declared_relationships.label: 当前开发阶段
declared_relationships.description: Links a drug to the development phase it is currently in, e.g. slpra-doc:Phase_ClinicalI (I期临床阶段).

declared_relationships.label: 含工艺中间体
declared_relationships.description:
Product/API-level multi-valued view derived from an explicitly linked final synthesis route or final synthesis step. It is not derived merely because a report mentions both a product and a route.
由已明确关联的最终合成路线或最终合成步骤推导出的产品/API级多值视图；不得仅因同一报告同时提及产品和路线而推导。

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 前品角色
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Role of the drug product manufactured before a changeover in shared-line assessment.

declared_properties.label: 残留物溶解度
declared_properties.description: Qualitative solubility descriptor: 易溶, 溶解, 微溶, 几乎不溶.

declared_properties.label: 残留物清洗溶剂
declared_properties.description: Solvent used to dissolve the residue for cleaning, e.g. 丙酮, 乙醇+水, 丙酮+2N三氟乙酸水溶液.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.label: 后品角色
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/dru.description: Role of the drug product manufactured after a changeover in shared-line assessment.

declared_properties.label: requires dedication
declared_properties.description: Set by SWRL rules based on drug product classification.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.label: 原料药登记人
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.description: CFDI 共线生产指南 §1.3：适用范围明确含原料药登记人。

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.label: 责任主体角色
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.description: Governance-tier role carrying decision/approval accountability; typically borne by an organization or senior management.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.label: 责任主体/参与方
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.description: Any party that can bear a GxP role and be held accountable in QRM — a natural person or an organization.

declared_relationships.label: 承担角色
declared_relationships.description: Realization link: an agent is the bearer of a GxP role (BFO bearer-of / realizable). Mirrors slpra-equip:hasEquipmentRole.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.label: 清洁验证角色
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.description: 清洁工艺设计开发→验证→持续确认三阶段：制定清洁验证方案与可接受限度、人员培训、批准最终验证报告。依据 §4.2 全节。

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.label: 受托药品生产企业
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.description: 受托生产方。CFDI 共线生产指南 §1.3、§2.2：根据共线情况开展共线生产风险评估并形成报告。

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.label: 受托生产企业角色
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.description: 开展共线生产风险评估、变更控制、清洁验证执行；新增共线品种时通报持有人。依据 §1.3 / §2.2 / §5.3。

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.label: 部门
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.description: 药品生产企业内部职能部门/业务单元，承担特定 GxP 角色，如质量部、生产部、设备部等。

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.label: EHS（职业健康防护）角色
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.description: 高毒/高活/激素类/细胞毒产品的人员防护与职业暴露限值（OEL）控制，保护操作员工健康安全。依据 §5.3 / 术语 OEL。会签矩阵既有责任角色之一。

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.label: 设备工程角色
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.description: 设备设计便于清洁，预防性维护，管道气密性测试、阀门点检、快接口检查。依据 §5.1.1 表5.1 共用设备模块控制措施。

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.label: 专业职能角色
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.description: Operating-tier role carrying a domain competency; typically borne by a natural person.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.label: GxP 角色
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.description: A role realized by an agent within GMP shared-line production quality risk management.

declared_properties.label: 角色代码
declared_properties.description: Stable machine code for a role (same value as the class-level skos:notation). Target for migrating the free-text ElectronicSignature.signer_role to a managed reference.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.label: 暖通空调（设施工程）角色
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.description: 洁净区分级与压差/气流设计，过滤器选型/更换周期与压差监测，防止空气传播交叉污染。依据 §5.1.3 表5.3 空气传播风险控制措施。

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.label: 上市许可持有人（主责）角色
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.description: 主体责任：提供品种药理毒理/HBEL 信息，审核批准受托企业共线生产风险评估报告并定期审核控制措施，评估清洁方法重现性，主导上市后风险管理。依据 CFDI 共线生产指南 §2.2 / §4.2.2 / §5.3。

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.label: 企业管理层角色
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.description: 定期审核回顾各阶段共线策略，重大变更后重新评估并审批。依据 §2.3 生命周期原则 / §2.4。

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.label: 上市许可持有人
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.description: 持有人。CFDI 共线生产指南 §2.2 主责原则：对持有品种共线生产的可行性与可控性负主体责任。

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.label: 药物警戒角色
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.description: 上市后不良反应监测、过敏反应跟踪、客户投诉归类与共线关联分析。依据 §4.1.8（青霉素/β-内酰胺）/ §5.3。

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.label: 生产操作（一线操作人员）角色
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.description: 参与可操作性评估（设备组装/运行/干预/拆卸/维修/清洁），执行规程，更衣与人流/物流管理。依据 §2.5 / §5.1.2。映射既有 RBAC 角色码 operator。

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.label: 生产工艺评估角色
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.description: 评估共线生产工艺路线的可行性与交叉污染风险，包括工艺参数、操作步骤、中间体暴露环节、批次切换清场等环节的风险识别与控制措施制定。依据 §3 / §5.1。

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.label: 质量保证（QA）角色
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.description: 审核批准风险评估报告与清洁验证报告，变更控制，偏差调查与纠正预防。依据 §2.2 / §4.2.2 / §5.1.2。映射既有 RBAC 角色码 qa。

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.label: 质量控制（分析检测）角色
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.description: 开发并验证足够灵敏的残留检测方法（HPLC/TOC 等），取样回收率研究，目视检查（需确认视力/照度）。依据 §3.2 / §4.2 / §4.2.3。

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.label: 注册法规角色
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.description: 参与研发阶段危害评估，确保法律法规优先（明确要求专用设施的品种不得共线）。依据 §3 / §2.1 法律法规优先原则。

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.label: 研发角色
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.description: 汇总/审核/分析临床前·临床药学·毒理·药效数据，识别最难清洁组分，设计清洁工艺、残留限度与检测方法。依据 §3「评估工作需研发、注册及具有药理、毒理学背景知识的人员参与」。

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.label: 毒理学专家角色
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.description: 制定 HBEL（PDE/ADE），危害分级；无 NOEL/LOEL 时以 TTC 估算 HBEL「需要毒理学专家的参与」——指南唯一显式要求参与的专业角色。依据 §3.1 / 附录1 危害等级判定。

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.label: 仓储管理角色
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/per.description: 原辅料与成品仓储管理，物料收发与台账，防止物料交叉污染与混淆，仓储条件合规管理。共线生产场景下需对共线品种物料实施标识隔离、专区存放等控制措施。

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/ris.label: 审批人小组
https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/ris.description: 风险评估报告的审批人小组，由具备审批权限的角色成员组成。

declared_relationships.description: Links a team to its member persons.

declared_relationships.description: Links a team to the GxP roles represented by its members.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/ris.description: 风险评估报告的评估小组，由承担特定 GxP 角色的成员组成。

declared_relationships.description: Links a team to its member persons.

declared_relationships.description: Links a team to the GxP roles represented by its members.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/ris.description: Covers hormonal, cytotoxic, and high-potency chemical drugs; may require independent HVAC or equipment dedication based on OEB/inactivation properties.

https://ontology.pharma-gmp.cn/slpra/ris.description: CFDI mandates fully dedicated and independent facilities for penicillin-type and β-lactam drugs.
